prompt: Plan the development of a local AI assistant on a low-end computer. The system must remain usable while running a local language model, memory system, monitoring system, and tools.
Create a phased plan for moving a local AI model from HDD to SSD later without redesigning the application architecture.
Plan how to benchmark three local language models fairly on the same computer.
Design a development sequence for an AI assistant where hardware monitoring must be completed before model inference is enabled.
Plan how JARVIS could gradually gain memory capabilities without allowing incorrect or unverified information to become permanent memory.
Create a plan for optimizing a local AI application using Python first, then selectively moving bottlenecks to C++.
Plan a recovery strategy for an AI assistant if the local model crashes during generation.
Design a plan for adding voice input and output to a local assistant while keeping the core brain independent from the voice system.
Plan how to test a new version of JARVIS without risking corruption of the existing working version.
Create a long-term architecture plan for a local-first AI assistant that can optionally use online services only when an internet connection is available.
